messages.text: Need my birth certificate for the robotics travel form?
Yours is in the blue folder. Mine is behind it, the older Oakland County one with Royal Oak typed on the top line.
ok found both. why do you have 3 copies
Passport renewals, school paperwork, and your grandmother's habit of keeping originals in three places.
robotics ran late again. can u get me at 6:10
Yes. I will bring your running bag too. Sarah and I were already moving dinner later.
is Em on FaceTime tonight or are we eating at normal table speed
She said she has a campus meeting, so it will be the three plates unless she calls after.
robotics ends 6:20. can u pick me up by the side door?
Can I put the game on before robotics? Just the first few innings.
Yes. Send the room number too, please. I am making the pickup list now so I do not circle the building twice.
Fine, but your bag needs to be by the door. Sarah and I are saving the quiet show for after you leave.
214. also pasta tonight?
The one where everyone talks super slowly and there are cliffs?
Pasta. I am starting sauce after I walk the block and stop rereading the staff email.
Probably. If the bullpen behaves, we may even get to it on time.
can you send the servo bracket vid again? the one with the guy using the drill press
I have it saved under the robotics playlist. I will send that plus the clamp jig one after dinner.
ok. also team page says meeting moved to thurs
I saw the post, but I will wait for the coach email before changing pickup.
Coffee Friday? I want to hear whether you survived the district K-5 design/build meeting.
Coffee Friday? I want to compare notes before the 7:15 agenda turns into fifty side speeches.
Friday works. I left with three pages of notes and a list of questions for Janet before I say yes to anything else.
Friday works. I only really need the curriculum pilot piece and the prep-period language.
Coffee Friday? I can bring the sign-up sheet for the middle school circuit tables.
Naturally. Some people just nod and find out later what they volunteered for.
Same. Also I am refusing to touch the board-race chatter in the lounge today.
Friday works. I also have the precinct walk packets in my car, so remind me before I leave.
Good plan. I checked the new item reports once this morning and closed the tab before it ate my prep.
I would rather know the travel days, teacher release time, and who owns the lesson bank before I step closer.
Of course you do. Nothing says restful week like batteries, clipboards, and school board maps.
If the board hears from parents before the vote, it is worth a tired Friday.
Saw your lunch-tab spreadsheet still had ferry times and park passes on it. That sheet is more organized than my gradebook.
It is mostly a mileage and motel math exercise right now. The lake loop is the sane version.
Coffee Friday before first bell? I can trade you one bad cafeteria muffin for one sane conversation.
And the Alberta columns?
Friday works if I am out by 7:25. I need to be home early that night for Jacob's indoor track pickup and the usual dinner shuffle.
Those stay shaded gray until Emily's housing bill and the plumber's estimate stop glaring at me.
Fair. Also saw your name off the curriculum committee list again. Keeping that one evening clean?
Yes. Wednesday stays closed to grading and meetings. Sarah has been firm about that, and she is right.
Dad's portal wants that family history page again. Do you still have your old benefits notes from 2020, or did you toss everything?
I kept the page with the three video appointments and the login receipt. Nothing medical was added to my chart from it.
I talked to Dad after dinner. He found the blue folder but not the small pill card from last visit.
I have a photo of the card from January. I will print it and bring the orange binder Thursday.
Good. Also please don't make a 12-step parent appointment spreadsheet tonight. One clean list is enough.
Good. Mom also asked if you still want the old drafting pencils from the basement desk before she donates boxes.
Too late on the first draft, but I will stop after I check the medication times once.
Yes, keep those aside. And tell her I can carry the book-sale boxes to her car after Dad's stop.
Long day tone in your last text. Leave the laptop closed when you get home, please.
I will. Ten minutes with the six-string before dinner might reset me.
Good. I put the blue song binder back by the chair, where Jacob will not trip over it.
Thanks. No inbox after that.
Campus clinic says I can do the spring dose Friday, but their chart is confusing.
Send me the screenshot. I want to compare it with Dr. Kline's portal note and the CDC timing table before you book it.
Dad, of course you have a timing table.
Only because the MSU page and the federal table used different wording. If they line up, Friday sounds fine.
can you still Venmo for the robotics kit tonight? deadline is 9
Yes, but remind me after dinner. The district deposit cleared this morning, so I can cover it.
how much is it
$184. I moved part of the 2,260.77 deposit to checking and left the rest for the mortgage bucket.
Coffee Friday before the first bell? Priya said she may swing by if the lab carts are not already on fire.
Friday works. I can do 7:05 at the usual place and still get back before kids start asking for goggles.
Good. Also, Dave texted me by mistake about your Saturday boots situation. I assume that means the March outing is alive.
Alive if the forecast holds. Leon is checking the parking lot conditions, and I am trying not to bring half the mud home.
Department chair wants two examples for how we updated units after 2020. You still using that housing map lesson?
Yes. I can bring the Detroit covenants excerpt and the school-boundary comparison. Those changed after Sarah and I went downtown with the candles.
Useful. I only have my water quality rewrite, which is less likely to start a parent email chain.
Mine has been fine if I keep it source-based and discussion-heavy. No slogans on the slides.
Jacob's robotics invoice came through: $185 due Friday. I can make soup if you want to skip Steve & Rocky's tonight.
Let's do soup. I moved the reservation off the calendar and left the clamp set in the online cart for now.
That works. I will grab bread after school tomorrow.
Thanks. The cart can wait until the Visa payment clears.
robotics pickup is 6:10 not 5:45
I can do 6:10. I will swing by the Oakland Schools lot after Sarah takes Emily's call.
ok. can we get noodles on way home
If Sarah says the fridge plan can wait, yes. Save room for Sunday with everyone here.
MSU says the March eBill posted. I can cover the $72 lab fee from campus hours if that helps.
Thanks, but leave your campus money alone. I marked the $1,260 payment for Monday after both district deposits clear.
Ok. Please don't let Mom skip the Saturday walk because of spreadsheets again.
Fair. The usual column is still around 8.7, this month just has the pipe repair sitting on top of it.
Do you still have the extra axle collars in your room or did the 7th graders use them all
There should be a small bag in the gray parts drawer. Please do not raid the bin marked 5th grade towers.
ok. Need them before the drive team test after practice
I can meet you by the shop door at 5:20 with the bag and the laptop cart key.
Can you take me to robotics at 6 or are you doing the envelope thing tonight
I can take you. I just need ten minutes after dinner to finish the school board boxes.
ok. mom said dont leave newspaper pieces all over my side of the table
Fair. I will keep the clippings in one pile and clear it before we go.
Campus panel used county school funding maps today. Your side of Woodward was basically glowing on every layer.
That sounds painfully accurate. The snowplow was on our street before 6 this morning and Jacob's lab has new sensors again.
Exactly. Nice for us, but wild when people act like everyone started at the same line.
Bring the map home over break. It would be useful for my juniors when we talk about where resources show up first.
Do we have extra hot glue sticks? Team used the last ones at practice.
Check the gray toolbox under the workbench. I am tightening the pantry hinge first, then I can look.
found 3. also are we eating before 6?
Yes. Chili is on low, and I need ten minutes to cover the basil starts before the temperature drops.
Dad's portal finally posted the $386 balance from last month's visit. I can call them Monday if you want.
Thanks. Do not send anything from Grand Rapids. I put it in our March sheet and can handle our half from checking if the statement is right.
Okay. I will just verify the coding and send you the screenshot. Mom also asked whether Sunday call is still 4.
Still 4. I will check the bank categories after breakfast so it lands in the right line.
I put the moleskin in the side pocket of your gray jacket before we head out.
Thanks. I will take the flatter route first and see how the right heel behaves.
I am heading out in ten. Did you write down this morning's cuff numbers before we go?
Yes, phone log is updated. I also put the little white one in before coffee.
Good. And please do the calf work before coffee this time, not after you stiffen up.
Good. Let us take the Cranbrook side streets today; they are quieter than Long Lake.
Fair. Cranbrook loop, then coffee, then I promise the green band.
Agreed. No earbuds for me. I could use the quiet after yesterday's grading pile.
Robotics is running late. Can you keep mine warm?
Yes. Chili should be ready around 6:35 if the peppers soften on time.
Is it the one with the red ones from outside?
Some of those, plus the last jar of tomatoes. Text when you leave school.
Coach says parent drivers need that district form by Fri
I uploaded mine. It asked for a lot more history than last year's form.
did u have anything weird to add
Just the same traffic stop from years ago and a bunch of blank boxes after that.
Mom asked whether you still have the folding tables from the Friends sale.
Two are in our garage. I can bring them Sunday after Dad's pill sorter is done.
Perfect. She also found your old summer reading card from Troy. You had truly tiny handwriting.
That sounds like Mom saving proof that I was serious at eight.
practice done at 5:35 not 5:15. coach added starts
I can get you at 5:40 by the south lot. Bring the spikes bag this time.
ok. robotics parts are also in my locker so don't let me forget
Noted. We will still be home for dinner before Sarah's meeting, and I am not opening school email after that.
Mom asked if you still have Dad's old red hymnal. She wants the page number for the tune Aunt Karen requested.
It's on the piano bench. I can send a photo after dinner. Same arrangement we sang growing up, I think.
That tracks. Also, do you want me to take the Grand Rapids drop-off for the pantry boxes, or are you already doing your Saturday run?
I have Saturday covered here. If you handle Grand Rapids, that keeps Mom from trying to lift anything.
FAFSA wants parent 2025 numbers again. Can I put the same estimate from winter break?
Use 86,400 for my district line until the W-2 import finishes. Sarah's page should already be in the file.
Did your staff meeting get weird after that state funding article I sent?
ok. and the form asks what comes in after deductions monthly?
A little, but I kept my comments on class size, lab materials, and what the kids actually need.
For mine, about 4,900 averaged over the year. I will double-check after Marcy looks at the flagged pages.
Very dad. Also please do not spend all night staring at those color-coded score boxes.
I already exported the small groups list and shut it down. Dinner is safer for everyone.
Before you leave, the printout for Robert is on the counter. I put it next to your coffee.
Thanks. I am adding the exact times from the portal so Megan and I are not comparing three versions.
Very you. Also Linda called last night about the paperback donations; she sounded pleased you remembered.
Dad trained me to measure twice, Mom trained me to return books on time. Apparently both stuck.
Did you ever use that scrap cedar from the garage? My office is doing a little seed-starting table and I thought of it.
Campus group chat is arguing about the same millage item you mentioned. Did you already mark yours?
Two pieces are left after I cut bases for Saturday's fan cart. I can save them by the mower.
Not yet. I am reading the League write-up again because the wording is not as plain as it should be.
Classic Dad. Send me the local article if it explains the funding part better.
I will. The county piece has a cleaner breakdown than the summary sheet.
Dad, only you would have cedar, a mower, and a fan cart in the same sentence.
Fair. I also need to get the water bill mailed before I forget, so the cedar will be safer than the envelope.
Dad, your email to the board was very you. Three citations and one sentence about lab goggles.
They asked for numbers. I gave them numbers. And the goggles line was necessary.
I liked the part about kids needing real experiments before anyone tells them science is not for them.
That is why I am giving up Saturday morning. The spreadsheet can wait.
Did you sleep or were you still rewriting tomorrow's lab directions at midnight?
I woke at 3:40 and fixed two wording issues that probably no one would notice.
Dad did you ever decide what to do about the budget email?
Drafted two versions, made a short pros-cons list, and sent the calmer one to your mother first.
Dad. That's exactly what you did with those three district calls in lockdown, except that actually helped.
Fair. The breathing notes from then are still better than rearranging every handout.
That is very you. Probably better than letting the comments section eat your night.
Exactly. I would rather talk to one real person and then make tea.
can you sign the meet form before school?
Yes. I am back from the 35-minute loop and cooling down in the kitchen.
ok also your black pair is by the garage door. mom said not the old brown ones
Tell your mother she is probably right. Long lab day and hallway duty.
can u sign the robotics field trip form? also coach said the roads by Lone Pine are clear for morning practice
Yes. Leave it on the counter next to the servicer envelope so I do not miss either one.
ok. and can I bike to Ben's after? streetlights are fixed now
If homework is done. I appreciate the lights being fixed, but text me when you get there.
Coffee Friday? I want to steal your 8th grade Mars rover sheet before our meeting eats the morning.
Friday works. I also need you to look at the mini-grant budget before I send it. The sensors line is still ugly.
Nothing says joy like arguing for ten more ultrasonic sensors before 8 a.m.
Coffee Friday? I need five minutes to complain about our lab budget and ten about last night's bullpen.
Friday works. I saw the 8th inning, then Sarah negotiated for the Oxford detective.
Bring the sarcastic pen. I have a new staff handout to trim too.
That is marriage diplomacy. Same table by the copy room?
Yes. I will bring the scoresheet and the resource request form, both equally depressing.
Mom asked whether you and Sarah were okay after the basement pipe thing. She worries when there is a repair truck in the driveway.
We're fine. Annoying timing, but between my Friday deposit and Sarah's next one the checking line should land near 9,400 for the month.
Good. Two school calendars and one old house is a very specific juggling act.
Exactly. I just want the Nelson invoice and Emily's portal payment to stop staring at me from the same page.
Mom says the attic box has your Hill Elementary class photo and my Smith one. Do you want those before I drive back?
Yes, please. The Troy stuff helps me keep the family timeline straight for Emily's project.
I also found Dad's little card with Grandpa Russell, Grandma Whitcomb, and the Clarks listed. Very Dad.
Bring it. Sarah asked for the short version, but Dad never did short versions.
The garage called. Front brake work on the Civic is estimated at $421. They can finish it tomorrow afternoon.
Go ahead and approve it. I will move it from the short-term savings line tonight and update the car tab.
Thank you. I was hoping we would not have to float it on the card while Jacob needs rides.
We should be fine. The house draft already cleared, and the Civic draft is not until the 18th.
Can you start the lentil soup if you get home first? I put the recipe printout on the counter.
Yes. I am checking the pan-sear video again because last time I crowded everything.
Please do not let that turn into three extra kitchen videos.
Fair. Also I saw the school-adjacent announcement about Friday pickup, but I want the district note before we rearrange the evening.
Tom stopped me at the driveway and asked whether you still wanted the extra set of poles from his garage.
Yes, if he truly does not need them. Mine are fine, but Dave always forgets something.
I told him you would check after dinner. Also, Saturday morning still ours before you disappear into grading?
Yes. Same loop, 8:30, phone away unless Jacob needs a ride.
Are you and Mom still doing carryout when I come home Saturday? I can eat before the train if not.
I might get in Saturday around 2 if the East Lansing bus behaves
Good. Your bed is mostly laundry right now, but it is clean laundry.
We are doing tacos at home. The MSU housing deposit and your brother's parts order landed in the same week.
classic. tell Jacob not to steal my desk chair again
Home tacos are honestly better. Did you buy that garage thing you were watching?
No, I bookmarked it for later. Nothing wrong with the old one for another month.
I will. Sarah already said we should do four places at dinner while you are here.
Campus group is asking alumni families to help with a sign-making night. I guessed you would say yes to supplies but no to being on the planning chat.
Accurate. I can send markers and poster board. I am not the right person to manage another thread.
Mom said you both still have the folded sign from downtown in the basement closet.
We do. It mattered to be there that evening, but I have been more useful changing what my juniors read and argue from evidence.
Dad, the page you sent about 2nd graders testing bridge shapes is actually useful. Less lecture-y than your usual drafts lol.
I will take that as progress. I am trying to make it something a tired teacher could use on a Tuesday, not a binder that sits on a shelf.
Keep the materials list at the top. People should not need six tabs open before kids start cutting cardboard.
Good point. I added a one-page prep check and a box for what can go wrong.
Coach needs the updated health form before regionals
I printed the record from Dr. Kline's portal this morning. We still need the clinic stamp from CVS.
Can we do it after robotics? dont want to miss drivetrain test
Yes. I checked the MDHHS note and the interval is okay for today, so we can stop at 6:20.
Dad's portal wants family details for the new care packet. Did you ever have anything more official than that stop outside Lansing?
No. Mine is still boring: license checks, a warning once, and one ticket a long time ago.
Same for our side as far as I know. I am leaving the uniformed-benefit and custody-history boxes empty unless Mom remembers something.
That matches what I know. I would not add anything that isn't in their actual paperwork.
If you and Mom go to Cranbrook after your box-packing thing, can you send me a pic of the Saarinen chairs?
That's the plan after the 9:00 shift. I also want to see the science wing exhibit before it closes.
Very on brand. Please don't make Mom read every wall label before lunch.
No promises. We have DIA tickets next weekend too, so I need to pace myself.
I found the old Cranbrook picnic photo in my desk drawer. Why was Jacob wearing safety goggles at age 7?
Because even then he thought every park visit in Oakland County needed a prototype.
Fair. Do you want me to bring that one home for Sarah's frame thing?
Yes, please. She is sorting the 2002-2026 stack and pretending it is not emotional.
If I get home by 6:20, can I claim the quinoa thing before Jacob inhales it?
Only if you rinse the beets. I have basil to cut and the tray of vegetables to start.
Deal. Also please tell me there are tomatoes for tomorrow.
A few on the counter, not many yet. I was aiming to put everything out at 6:30.
can we leave the cans in your trunk? robotics room is full
Yes. Put the pasta boxes on the left so they don't crush the cereal.
ok. also i finished the English outline before practice
Good. Bring it with you and I will look it over after the drop-off.
garage door guy left. mom said dont touch the button
Good. I will look at the quote tonight after your meet.
does that kill the mountains thing
It probably moves the big map back. A few days along Superior is easier to keep on the table.
Can I move the black case from the hallway or is that for tomorrow
Leave it by the stairs. Your aunt asked if I still remember Country Roads after dinner.
ok but if everyone sings loud I am going to the basement
Fair. I only need a few songs before I check out for the night.
Coffee before the staff circus, or are you doing your parking-lot laps first?
Laps first. I skipped yesterday and the numbers looked better when I got back to the routine.
Fair. I'll defend the table from freshmen buying muffins.
Thanks. I need to grab water too; the new refill dries me out a little.
Sunday call still 7:30? Mom wants to tell you about the display she helped sort, and Dad has two new numbers from the monitor sheet.
7:30 works. Send me a picture of the sheet first so I can put it in the same table as last time.
Will do. He laughed that your columns look like one of his old shop drawings.
I will take that as a compliment. I also have Mom's donation receipt in the glove box.
I will be home closer to 6:20. Should I pick anything up?
No, I have rice going and the chicken is in the oven. I replaced the cracked hose washer too, so the side spigot should stop dripping.
Thank you. The community center emailed again about your table for Friday evening.
Are you going back to school tonight or was that room 214 item cancelled?
I saw it. The small trebuchet is packed, and I will print the sign after I reconcile the Visa charges.
Still going. The agenda has the planning-block wording and the curriculum pacing chart, so I should be there.
Then eat before you go. And please do not reopen the student results screen when you get home.
Fair. I will take notes, ask my two questions, and leave the laptop closed after 8.
Emily just texted me that her exam week is piling up. She sounded tired but still planning to come home Saturday.
I will call her after Jacob's track dinner. He wants pasta before the Saturday meet, so I picked up extra.
Good. And tonight stays clear, correct? No opening the parent conference notes after the dishes.
Correct. I already sent the one reply I owed and shut the laptop.
Coffee Friday? I have three lab carts and one working outlet. Living the dream.
Coffee tomorrow? Also someone posted that miracle classroom air filter thing again.
Friday works. I already made a tiny agenda, which is how you know the week has teeth.
Coffee works. Send me the manufacturer sheet, not the reposted graphic.
There he is. I will bring the sheet and you bring the cranky standards.
Bring it. I will bring caffeine and my usual bad district theories.
Deal. I watched a teardown last night, so I have questions about the fan rating.
Deal. I am walking the long hallway loop before first bell so I do not start the day by fixing all 12 things at once.
I am leaving the office in ten. Do we need anything besides spinach, pasta, and Jacob's cereal?
Maybe coffee. I already took the towels out of Emily's room and put the robotics parts back in the basement.
Thank you. The evenings still feel oddly quiet when Jacob is at practice.
I know. I keep setting the table too wide and then remembering what night it is.
For my family background chart, do I put Royal Oak hospital or Troy for your first square?
Use Royal Oak for the document line and Troy for the years that actually shaped me.
Got it. Also the form has that two-step ancestry box thing. Same as yours from school HR?
Yes. I left the first yes/no line as no and used the same first box on the next row that HR already has.
Coffee Tuesday? I want to compare notes before the district tech meeting eats my planning hour.
Tuesday works. I have to call the loan servicer after first bell, then I am free before lunch.
Living the dream. Also, saw your parent group raised enough for another robotics cart.
Coffee still on? I refuse to discuss the lab supply order before caffeine.
That is part of what bothers me. One community quietly replaces equipment while another teacher is begging for batteries.
Yes. I already checked the order twice and made a backup seating chart for no sane reason.
Bring the chart if it makes your jaw stop doing that thing. Also HR sent the yearly benefits reminder. Same link as the 2020 video-call thing.
I saw it. Useful in 2020, but I don't have anything active to renew.
For Sunday, Mom says she is bringing pie and wants the old Dylan one after we eat.
Tell her I can manage that if my fingers cooperate.
She said it beats watching you answer school messages at the table.
She is not wrong. I will keep the phone in the kitchen.
Are you still meeting that company person Monday, or did you decide the classroom won again?
I am taking the call so I can close the loop cleanly. The numbers are real, but so are the 147 kids I would leave midstream.
That sounds like you. Did you make the full comparison sheet?
Two tabs and a handwritten list. Commute, travel nights, retirement, Jacob's spring schedule, and what the work would actually be after the demos.
My office has a Japan exchange student event next month and now I am sending you a Kyoto street food list.
Send it. I still have the shrine walk and rail-pass notes from the winter break folder.
You kept those? adorable. also sorry my housing deposit is rude.
That deposit gets handled first. The folder can sit there a while without complaining.
Priya says your classroom cart is in my room again. I am taking this as payment for listening to your April route debate.
Fair. Leon wants Maybury if the west side dries out, Dave is lobbying for Proud Lake because he likes punishment.
That is a very specific committee for mud avoidance.
A small committee, at least. Tom only weighed in because he knows the back entrance.
Robert's new prescription pickup was $74. I paid today, but can you cover the portal balance Monday?
Yes. I already crossed off the Bistro Joe's lunch after church, so Monday is fine.
Thank you. I know you were also eyeing that shelf for the basement.
It can stay on the list. The basement has waited this long.
Dad says the pharmacy mentioned another senior dose, but he was not sure if it was for him or Mom.
Have him wait until I check the Corewell summary and the Michigan page. The pharmacy reminder sometimes lags the chart.
Good. I will tell them not to guess based on the postcard.
Thanks. If Dr. Shah's office confirms it Monday, I can help schedule both of them.
A colleague here is doing another Saturday courthouse gathering and asked if I knew anyone on your side of the state who helps coordinate those things.
I am not a coordinator. Sarah and I showed up once when our district friends were going, but I would only be useful passing along a flyer.
That is still helpful. Do you want me to tell her you are better with school-board wording than clipboard tables?
That is fair. I can review a district policy paragraph if she has one.
I picked up the salad kit. Are you still planning to have that Honolulu blue pregame on while you fold towels?
Only until dinner. After that I saved the episode with the village fundraiser and the missing ledger.
Good. I can handle one coach interview, not a whole evening of it.
Deal. I will keep the remote visible this time.
Coffee Friday? I can listen to the annual Sarah-table-reservation panic before first bell.
Friday works. I am trying to pick a place that does not make us feel like we are still the new people from 2002.
In this county? After Emily's science fairs and Jacob's meets, you lost new-person status years ago.
I fixed my retirement box in the Intuit file. Did you add the classroom supply note?
Yes. I also attached the district statement showing 26 entries from August through July and the 86,400 total.
Good. Please leave the 529 and reimbursement questions for Marcy instead of guessing.
Already flagged. I will send her the export after Jacob's ride.
Coffee at 7:25? I am already pretending the copier will behave.
Give me five. Finished the Tuesday loop and still need the calf band before I sit down.
Wear the pair you were bragging about. We have double labs and a staff meeting marathon.
Already on. The old pair is retired until my heel stops arguing with me.
Coffee Friday? I need five minutes away from lab supply forms before they become my personality.
Friday works. I am bringing the laptop because I still have to reconcile March before first bell.
That sounds very you. Did the brake surprise wreck the month?
Annoying, not wrecked. It came out of the cushion, and the regular house and car drafts stayed on schedule.
Are you bringing home the 6th grade notebooks again, or can we keep the dining table clear tonight?
Only the notebooks with failed pulley sketches. The 8th grade Python files can wait until morning.
Good. Please also leave the new-teacher slide deck at school if you can.
Deal. I already added the photo steps for the circuit stations, so it can stay on my desk.
My office has extra campus zines from the waste audit. Want me to save any for your classroom shelf?
Yes, two copies if they are spare. Students actually pick those up when they have a minute.
Also did you renew that Baldwin card online or are you still carrying the 1990s one like a museum piece
Renewed. The old one stays in the drawer with your first report card.
Aunt Megan posted old lake photos and tagged you. Mom will want you to actually react this time.
I saw them when I checked the trail club event. I will add a comment before I close it.
Also please tell me you did not learn the whole guitar part from a twelve-minute basement video.
Only the intro. The chord change finally made sense after slowing it down.
do you still need my soldering kit tonight
Yes, just the spare iron and wire strippers. I am showing the seventh graders the simple sensor board before we sort the last postcards.
ok. please don't lose the good tip
Fair. I will put it back in the red case before I leave the community center.
Coffee before the staff meeting? I need someone else who got stuck on the volunteer packet.
Coffee next Friday? I can listen to your rant about the budget if you bring the good Cranbrook exhibit notes.
Yes. Mine went through after I answered the courthouse-history page and skipped the preference-credit attachment.
Deal. I still owe you the photo from the mineral room. Sunday ran long with anthem rehearsal and the lunch crew.
Same. The form makes a speeding ticket feel like a memoir.
Of course it did. You pack lunches, sing tenor, then tour museums like it's a second job.
Exactly. Mine was one short note and then mostly empty fields.
There are worse ways to spend a weekend. Friday coffee works if we keep it before first bell.
For Easter, should I bring the leaf for your table or are you already stretching it?
Bring it. When Emily is in from MSU and Mom and Dad come, our usual setup looks too small.
Got it. Need me to bring extra sheets too?
One set for the den would help. Emily has her room, Jacob has his, and Sarah already washed ours.
Dad's portal finally shows the April 2 appointment. I can handle the insurance call if you are already juggling school and Jacob's meet week.
Thank you. I have the meet at 4:30 Wednesday and Emily coming in Friday, so that would help.
Done. Also, please do not volunteer for another committee slot just because someone asks nicely.
I learned that lesson last fall. I sent the polite regret and kept Wednesday evening blocked.
For Sunday, should I bring bread or are you doing one of your big pots?
Bring bread if you want. I am making chili after Jacob gets back, probably on the table near 6:30.
Mom asked whether it has those peppers she likes.
Yes, the mild ones. I also have basil and a few tomatoes if Sarah wants a side salad.
I can look at the insurance letter after dinner if you want. Send the PDF, not a screenshot.
Thank you. I highlighted the dates and made a three-item question list. I am trying not to turn it into a whole research project.
